turns.text: Hey! Saturday is off to a great start. Since I didn't have to travel anywhere for work or do any kind of commuting today, I got to sleep in quite a bit. Dash was more than happy to just laze around in bed with me.

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! Instead of my usual morning coffee, I decided to treat myself and heated up a big mug of rich hot cocoa. It felt so cozy and perfect for a lazy Saturday morning.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, that sounds absolutely delicious! A warm mug of hot cocoa is the perfect way to lean into a relaxing weekend. How have things been going with the wedding planning lately? Have you and Tom made any progress on your plans for summer 2028?

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: Definitely an evening ceremony, or at least somewhere with a really great indoor backup space with strong air conditioning! Tucson summers are intense. Tom is very focused on making sure our guests will be comfortable, which I appreciate.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's very thoughtful of Tom. A comfortable guest is a happy guest! Amidst all the wedding discussions, have you had any time to work on your online Italian course lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually did a couple of vocabulary units on Thursday evening. I'm trying to practice for at least fifteen minutes a few times a week. The grammar is getting a little trickier now, but I'm still really enjoying the challenge.

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: I actually fed my starter yesterday, so I think I might prep a loaf tonight to bake tomorrow morning. Dash loves watching me shape the dough on the counter—I think he just hopes I'll accidentally drop a piece of cheese or something. Anyway, Tom and I are about to take him over to the park since it's such a beautiful afternoon.
